rows.line: そのための自分たちの判断基準って何っていうところ
rows.en1: Like, what do we even judge by?

rows.line: これが結構本当にその通りなんですけど
rows.en1: That's so true.

rows.line: 意外と日本の既存の会社ができない
rows.en1: Surprisingly, most companies can't pull that off.
rows.en2: You'd think it's easy, but most places can't do it.

rows.line: 物理的にちょっと見れなくなってきて
rows.en1: I just couldn't keep eyes on everything.
rows.en2: There weren't enough hours in the day.

rows.line: 仕方ないかと、もうこれ任せるしかないと
rows.en1: Oh well.

rows.line: もうこれ任せるしかないと
rows.en1: I just have to trust them.
rows.en2: Nothing to do but let go.

rows.line: 1年間はちょっと耐え忍ぶと思って
rows.en1: I figured I'd just grit my teeth for a year.
rows.en2: I'd ride it out for a year.

rows.line: よくよく考えたらなるほどなって感じだった
rows.en1: When I really thought about it, it made sense.

rows.line: 何か提案しても結局社長の意見になるし
rows.en1: It always ends up being my call.
rows.en2: It always comes back to the boss.

rows.line: 今でこそね、結構いろんなところで
rows.en1: These days, sure, but...

rows.line: もうこれ以上1人でやってももう無理だ
rows.en1: I couldn't do it alone anymore.

rows.line: 思考回路が180度変わって
rows.en1: My whole way of thinking flipped.
rows.en2: It turned my thinking completely around.

rows.line: これ我慢できるもんなんですか
rows.en1: Can you really hold back like that?
rows.en2: How do you even sit on your hands?

rows.line: 見ず知らずの大人15人が3ヶ月後にはチームになって
rows.en1: a bunch of total strangers

rows.line: これだと思った。もう腹落ち
rows.en1: That's it. It totally clicked.
rows.en2: It made total sense in my gut.

rows.line: 会社がもうめちゃくちゃになりましたね
rows.en1: The company was a total mess.

rows.line: チームなんていらねえだろうみたいなね
rows.en1: Who needs a team?
rows.en2: We don't need that team stuff.

rows.ja: そんなことやるより仕事しろよ
rows.line: そんなことやるより仕事しろよみたいな
rows.en1: Quit wasting time and get to work.

rows.line: この売上厳しい時に何をやってんだってなりますよね
rows.en1: What are you even doing?
rows.en2: Are you kidding me right now?

rows.ja: ボロボロになりつつも
rows.line: みんなが反抗して、もうボロボロになりつつも
rows.en1: Even while everything was falling apart...

rows.line: 取り組んでいるうちに1年経って2年経って
rows.en1: Before I knew it, a year went by, then two.
rows.en2: You keep at it, and a year or two goes by.

rows.line: ひょっとしていいことかもしれないみたいな
rows.en1: Maybe this is actually a good thing?

rows.line: 輪がだんだん広がってきて
rows.en1: It slowly caught on.
rows.en2: More and more people got on board.

rows.line: そういえばあの時に
rows.en1: Oh yeah, back then...

rows.line: ここはちょっともうギリギリダメだ
rows.en1: That's pushing it too far.

rows.line: ここのチーム作りちょっとやめとこうみたいな
rows.en1: Let's hold off on that.

rows.line: 今では考えられないんですけどね
rows.en1: Hard to imagine now.

rows.line: 採用だけに特化した制作物っていうのに振り切って
rows.en1: We went all in on hiring stuff.

rows.line: すごいバチバチに攻めたサイトとかを作ってた
rows.en1: really bold, in-your-face sites

rows.line: 見た目だけこう取り繕っていう状態だった
rows.en1: It was all just for show.
rows.en2: It looked good on the surface, that's it.

rows.line: いい会社を作らないと結局うまくいかんな
rows.en1: It's not going to work unless the company's good.
rows.en2: If the company's not good, nothing works.

rows.line: 経営理念を掲げてない会社ってほぼ皆無なんです
rows.en1: There's basically none.

rows.line: 誰のためにっていうのがない。全部ひっくるめて
rows.en1: all of it lumped together

rows.line: これ2025年までやりきる
rows.en1: We're going to see it through.

rows.line: いや俺そんなの聞いてないとかね
rows.en1: Nobody told me about this.
rows.en2: That's not what I signed up for.
